name: Deep resonance
description: Three rings off the same silent point, the outer one heavy where the weapon's is a hairline. The Chirp has no body to compose — it is a sound — so the upgrade is drawn as how far and how hard the sound goes. Polish: the rings no longer fade by alpha — a translucent ring on the dark panel was a blurry ring — but step down in tone from a near-white centre through light, mid and dark frost; each ring sits on an ink ring of its own; the centre disc was grown to meet the inner ring, because a dark gap inside a bright ring was an eye; and the radii were nudged off an even spacing.

glyph.description: Plate off, object only — the silhouette a collection shows for an entry not yet met.
